row.title: Intent Yield enters SEED-LIFECYCLE-1
row.body: instance.json and lifecycle.json added (served by ultrastable-site, verify https://ultrastable.io/yield.json for INTENT-YIELD-1); progress row healed by intent-yield.yml and executor.yml. Stage is deployed; the watchdog's seedlife verify takes it to live. Q-SEED-intent-yield closes on seedlife --probe once the core-inherited survival classes (cost-alerts, dependencies, runtime, backups, improvement) close platform-wide. Superseded 2026-11-22: Intent Yield is a core feature, not a seed; the manifest and lifecycle file were removed and this row now points at the design doc.
